This is not independent review, real-credential custody or domain activation.
Public dependency/acceptance tracker and six tracker-validation tests on Linux/macOS. This is not a running server or a completed schema/security contract gate.

Pinned compiler source/protocol profile and synthetic local-source compatibility fixture for future standalone luc adapters. Fresh local and Linux/macOS CI bootstraps, five profile/protocol unit tests and 70 real compiler commands pass: both languages in six modes before/after source relocation, transitive native linking, same-source nominal identity, distinct package error owners, argv fidelity, emitted-Base owner metadata, ten negative graph builds and an explicit unavailable-interop probe. Tiny C files are test-only linker sentinels, not runtime engines. Languages and user projects unchanged; direct ErrorCode-return interop and main argv conventions documented. This is not an installer, resolver, frozen manifest/lock schema, OS-enforced offline or M7/registry acceptance; M0 identity/release/storage/proxy decisions remain open.

Initial native bounded whole-buffer zlib core, consumed-byte reporting, Luce ownership and eight independent workers; 646 oracle/negative cases per compiler mode, all six modes plus ASan/UBSan on Linux/macOS and isolated VPS suite. Incremental streaming/raw framing were not implemented at this checkpoint.

Native incremental raw-DEFLATE/zlib decoder with fixed 37960-byte retained state, exact consumed counts, backpressure, sticky EOF, budgets, poison/reset and owning Luce facade. Per mode: 646 whole-buffer, 1846 incremental and 24 stock-Git loose/packed zlib boundary cases plus native/Luce/eight-worker suites. Six modes and ASan/UBSan passed locally and on Linux/macOS CI; verified Linux bundle passed isolated VPS suite with unchanged live services. Incremental encoding, allocator-fault injection, cooperative work limits, measured memory/performance and full Git integration remained open at this checkpoint.

Native deterministic incremental raw-DEFLATE/zlib encoder and owning Luce Deflater; fixed 557448-byte retained storage, no native step allocations, EOF/backpressure/budgets/reset and eight 512 KiB-stack workers. Per mode: 5072 codec fixture cases including 2556 encoder cases, independent zlib reads and stock-Git reads of Base-encoded loose/packed objects, plus native/Luce/lifetime suites. Six modes and ASan/UBSan passed locally and on Linux/macOS CI; verified Linux bundle passed isolated VPS suite with unchanged live services. A compiler stack-initializer limitation was documented outside language sources and avoided within the package. M1a allocator-fault, cooperative-work, memory/performance and further fuzz gates remained open at this checkpoint; full Git integration belongs to M2a.

368 deterministic Base-heap allocation-failure/retry cases, exact live pointer/size ledger, constructor/growth/result-shell unwind, raw/zlib owning stream state and EOF preservation, late codec-error cleanup and native allocation-free step/reset/close proofs. Production codecs and languages unchanged. Existing 5072 codec fixtures plus native/Luce/workers still pass in six modes and ASan/UBSan locally and on Linux/macOS; verified Linux bundle passed isolated VPS suite with unchanged live services. Ledger peak 590720 requested bytes is scoped, not process RSS or an aggregate server bound. Finite test traces exclude OS/libc/startup and managed Luce/GC exhaustion. Cooperative-work, process-memory/performance and further stress/fuzz gates remain open; no registry or CLI acceptance claim.

Native and owning incremental APIs bound each call to 1-65536 state-machine dispatches (default 4096), report actual work and resume yielded partial state/EOF, including zero-I/O yields. Owner-side cancellation/reset/direct unfinished close, retained output and eight 512 KiB-stack workers are tested. 6000 codec fixtures (928 new work cases), 388 counted allocation-failure/retry cases and native/Luce suites pass in all six local and Linux/macOS CI modes plus ASan/UBSan. Disk-interrupted local gates were rerun after cleanup, not counted as passes. Verified nine-binary/six-script Linux bundle passed isolated VPS suite with unchanged live services. Dispatch bounds are not deadlines or asynchronous close; 590736-byte allocation ledger is not process/aggregate memory. Languages and image source unchanged. M1a measured memory/latency and further stress/fuzz gates remain open; full Git, registry and standalone luc acceptance are later gates.

Base fixed-buffer streaming stress with independent worker-owned codec pairs, one/eight capped-stack workers, exact-child OS peak RSS, step-duration histograms and paired-pipeline throughput. Five quick cases plus the existing 6000 codec/388 allocation/native/Luce suites pass in all six local and Linux/macOS modes, ASan/UBSan and isolated VPS. Eleven full native-opt-3 cases pass locally and on both CI hosts, including 16/128 MiB growth checks and a 4294967297-byte stream without large files/allocations. Verified ten-binary/seven-script Linux bundle passed under unchanged VPS limits in 123.591 seconds; exact stage removed and all live services unchanged. OS metrics include startup/runtime effects; paired pipeline, timing and memory observations are not independent oracle coverage, deadlines or aggregate server capacity. Production codec, languages and image unchanged. M1a independent larger-stream/fuzz validation and M0 review remain open; no Git service, real registration or luc acceptance claim.

Independent bounded decoder fuzz batches and larger file-stream oracles. Each of six local/Linux/macOS compiler modes and ASan/UBSan retains previous suites and adds 4096 seeded decoder cases plus 24 file-stream byte/EOF/budget cases. Both hosted native-opt-3 jobs and local runs pass 65536 second-seed mutations (22380 accepted, 43156 rejected), 48 file cases through 16 MiB+3 bytes and all eleven full resource cases. Seven new oracle/diagnostic unit tests pass; writable failures retain exact batches and read-only storage errors preserve the original failure. Verified twelve-binary/nine-script Linux bundle passes the complete isolated VPS suite in 151.113 seconds with unchanged 180-second/25%-CPU/512-MiB limits, including the new 4096/24 quick cases. Exact stage removed and all live services unchanged. Production codecs/languages/image unchanged. Planned compression validation has local/CI/VPS evidence; M1a remains in progress because M0 is incomplete. No exhaustive/coverage-guided/independent-security-review, full Git, registry, deployment or real luc acceptance claim.

Native FIPS 202 SHAKE128/256 and FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 keygen/sign/verify on ChaCha20-Poly1305/XChaCha/SHA-1. Six local/Linux/macOS modes and ASan/UBSan retain prior SHA-2/keyed/Argon2id/AEAD suites. Zero-seed ML-DSA-65 public keys match OpenSSL 3.6 hexseed; OpenSSL pkeyutl signatures verify where the host OpenSSL provides ML-DSA-65, otherwise that interop is skipped. Verified 39-member Linux bundle passes the isolated-host quick suite in 64.947 seconds / 16.106 seconds CPU under unchanged 180-second/25%-CPU/512-MiB limits. Exact stage removed, live applications and reverse proxy unchanged. Not HashML-DSA, ACVP corpora, constant-time review, calibrated vault costs or real credentials. M0/M1b remain incomplete.

Native RFC 8439 ChaCha20/Poly1305, IETF AEAD, XChaCha20-Poly1305 (24-byte nonce via HChaCha20) and isolated FIPS 180-4 SHA-1 for Git object IDs. Six local/Linux/macOS modes and ASan/UBSan retain prior SHA-2/keyed/Argon2id suites and add RFC block/Poly1305/AEAD vectors, XChaCha round-trip, tag-fail wipe and SHA-1 empty/abc digests. No foreign crypto runtime. This is not ML-DSA, calibrated vault costs, constant-time review or real credentials.

Six local/Linux/macOS modes, ASan/UBSan, 17 harness tests, all prior SHA-2/keyed cases, 873 BLAKE2b/H' records, 493 Argon2id derivations, RFC prehash/pass-state/tag, 32 combined heap-failure paths, nine matrix/worker paths, admission/rounding/overlap/eight-caller tests pass. Verified 34-member Linux bundle passes the full isolated-host quick suite in 68.228 seconds / 16.969 seconds CPU under unchanged 180-second/25%-CPU/512-MiB limits; extended memory cases remain local/CI-only. Exact stage removed, live applications and reverse proxy unchanged, corpus hashes identical across three Python versions. Relocated macOS prebuilt suite also passes and its temporary stage was removed. No foreign crypto runtime, language-source change, real credential or live service mutation. This is not calibrated costs, aggregate admission, frozen vault/signature formats, whole-library constant-time/copy-erasure analysis or independent review. Owner-accepted v1 algorithms are ML-DSA-65 signatures and Argon2id + XChaCha20-Poly1305 vaults; encodings, costs and review remain open. M0/M1b and authentication/TLS/registry/standalone luc acceptance remain incomplete.

Body retention and byte-buffer zeroing are not whole-library constant-time/copy/register/spill/swap/core-dump erasure guarantees or independent review. M0/M1b, other crypto primitives, hardened custody, authentication, TLS, registry and luc acceptance remain incomplete.

Not persistence, recovery, devices, reviewed custody or M2b complete.

Numeric SemVer parse, 0.x caret selection, luce.lock schema_version=1 origin encode/parse and SHA-256 source digest via luce-crypto. Six local/Linux/macOS modes and ASan/UBSan. Compilers still do not read the lockfile. Not a resolver, TUF client, archive/cache, installer or M2c complete.
